name: SuQing's Freshness Lunchbox
description: 0.1.0-rc.5 single-player ground-outline candidate: a separate world sprite rendered from the actual ground mesh replaces the inventory-icon fallback. The inventory icon, held/ground models, freshness logic and upgrades are retained. This fixed-yaw fallback improves shape and size; arbitrary rotation and camera alignment require user gameplay acceptance. A real single-handed food container with gradual restoration and independent sandbox settings. Vanilla starting capacity 4, weight 1, weight reduction 50%. All directly stored eligible food restores together. Works in carried and loaded world storage, with validated game-time catch-up for recorded food. No real-world offline credit. The newer ordinary Container Upgrades main mod includes optional upgrade support with no compatibility submod. The lunchbox works independently without ordinary upgrades. This candidate preserves the current HavenFall EX crafting chain and ledger checks. Single-player candidate, user gameplay acceptance pending.
